describe.description: The creature is a large upright chimera shown in right-facing profile, rearing on its hind legs with wings fully spread. It has the head and shaggy mane of a lion at the front top, a deep chest and upper back covered in overlapping feather-like scales, a pair of large broad bird wings extending laterally from the upper torso, and the spotted torso, hindquarters, hind legs and long tufted tail of a large feline. The coloration is predominantly golden-tan and light brown with darker brown feather tips and numerous dark rosette spots on the lower body, legs and tail, set against a plain off-white background.
